observedTests.name: clean full-pack Forge loader probe
observedTests.phase: Java module-layer resolution before mod construction
observedTests.error: java.lang.module.ResolutionException: Modules replaymod and org.groovymc.gml.groovyjij.com.fasterxml.jackson.core.jackson.core export package com.fasterxml.jackson.core

blockers: The shadow JAR exports Jackson packages already supplied by the installed Groovy/Jar-in-Jar module, so the MilkyCraft Vanilla+ Forge module layer cannot resolve.
The published META-INF/mods.toml contains unresolved build placeholders and reports mod version 0.
The upstream tracker has an open multiplayer replay playback failure report.

candidates.name: Free Camera

observedTests.name: clean full-pack Forge loader probe
observedTests.error: freecamera-1.20.1-forge-2.2.0.jar needs language provider javafml:62 or above; Forge 47.4.10 provides javafml 47

blockers: The published 1.20.1 artifact declares javafml loaderVersion [62,), so it cannot load on Forge 47.4.10.

The legacy implementation sets the local player's noPhysics flag and cancels normal player input while active; that does not meet this task's conservative multiplayer movement/network safety requirement.
The legacy build lacks the requested follow and camera-path recording features.
